mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN bs.point_currency_id IS NOT NULL THEN pt.discount_amount * pc.krw_per_point ELSE pt.discount_amount END ), 0) AS totalReceivedBenefit, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN bs.point_currency_id IS NULL THEN pt.discount_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS totalDiscountAmount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN bs.point_currency_id IS NOT NULL THEN pt.discount_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS totalPoint FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON pt.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id LEFT JOIN benefit_service bs ON pt.applied_benefit_service_id = bs.service_id LEFT JOIN point_currency pc ON bs.point_currency_id = pc.point_currency_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND pt.transaction_status = 'APPROVED' AND DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}

SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS yearMonth, COALESCE(SUM(pt.amount), 0) AS spendAmount FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON pt.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id JOIN store s ON pt.store_id = s.store_id JOIN category c ON s.category_id = c.category_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND pt.transaction_status = 'APPROVED' AND DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m') BETWEEN #{fromYearMonth} AND #{toYearMonth} GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, DATE_FORMAT(pt.paid_at, '%Y-%m')

SELECT cp.card_product_id, cp.card_name, cp.card_image_url, cp.detail_url FROM card_product cp JOIN user_card uc ON uc.card_product_id = cp.card_product_id AND uc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cp.card_product_id NOT IN ( SELECT card_product_id FROM user_card WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ) GROUP BY cp.card_product_id, cp.card_name, cp.card_image_url, cp.detail_url ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_id) DESC, cp.card_product_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
